# Gentle Yoga With Penny

> Small, friendly gentle Hatha Yoga classes in Berkhamsted and Hemel Hempstead, Hertfordshire, UK, taught by British Wheel of Yoga (BWY) qualified teacher Penny Cronyn since 2004. Face-to-face classes on Monday, Tuesday and Thursday, plus a live Wednesday evening class on Zoom. Suitable for beginners and for older adults; many students are in their 60s, 70s and 80s.

Contact: penny.cronyn@gmail.com, 07958 616470 (+44 7958 616470). New students can book a one-off trial session before committing to a block (classes are booked a term at a time).

Weekly classes (75 minutes each, prices per session):

- Monday 7:45pm, The Court House, Church Lane, Berkhamsted HP4 2AX, £12
- Tuesday 12:30pm and 2:00pm, Leverstock Green Village Hall, Hemel Hempstead HP3 8QG, £10
- Wednesday 7:00pm, online via Zoom, £9
- Thursday 2:00pm, Carey Baptist Church, Marlowes, Hemel Hempstead HP1 1LD, £10 (spaces available for new students)

The site describes what a class is; it makes no medical or therapeutic claims. Anyone managing a health condition is advised to speak to a GP or physiotherapist first.
